primitives.note: Nimbus Strike deals magic damage on the dash (fixed cast, no windup)
Crushing Blow arms Wukong's next basic attack with bonus physical damage, extra range and an uncancellable windup
The Crushing Blow attack resets Wukong's basic attack timer, letting another auto-attack (or ability) chain immediately
Crushing Blow's landed attack shreds a percent of the target's armor for 3s
Every instance of damage Wukong (or his clone) deals reduces Crushing Blow's cooldown by 0.5s
Strength of Stone stacks (up to 5, 5s refresh, 1/sec falloff) scale Stone Skin's bonus armor and % max-health regen; defensive, matters for the survival fight
Nimbus Strike grants Wukong bonus attack speed for 5s on arrival
Cyclone ticks physical damage (%max HP + AD ratio) every 0.25s while spinning
Cyclone ends after up to 2s and can/does recast for a second 2s spin within an 8s window, with a 1s lockout before the recast is available
Mana costs (esp. W 60-40, E 30-50 rising with rank, R flat 100) can meaningfully cap casts inside a 15s fight depending on mana pool/regen
Warrior Trickster's clone persists for 4s, auto-attacks independently, and can mirror Q/E/R effects at reduced (CloneDamageMod) damage, acting as a second damage source

needsBespoke.why: The W clone is not a simple fire-and-forget pet: it auto-attacks on its own timer AND, if Wukong casts Q, E's attack-speed buff, or R while the clone exists (or simultaneously), the clone replicates that ability's effects at CloneDamageMod (40%-60%) damage, running its own copy of Crushing Blow's empowered attack / Cyclone's tick-DoT in parallel with Wukong's. The closed primitive list's pet-or-summon assumes an independent damage source but does not capture 'mirrors the caster's other ability casts, scaled by a separate damage modifier, with its own attack-reset/empowered-attack/dot interactions.' Simulating this faithfully needs bespoke logic layering the same primitives a second time on a second actor timeline.
